plain.li: {ABOUT_nameDef} is lying in a cell, unarmed. Killing them now isn't justice, it's just killing.
If we start executing prisoners, what stops us executing each other when it's convenient?
I patched {ABOUT_nameDef} up myself. I'm not watching them get shot after that.
[afterraid] Everyone's angry. That's the worst time to decide who dies.

warm.li: Please, {OTHER_nameDef}. I know you're hurting. This won't fix it.
{ABOUT_nameDef} has people somewhere too. Someone is waiting for them to come home.
[trait:Kind] I'll feed {ABOUT_nameDef} from my own plate if that's the problem. Just don't do this.

blunt.li: You want blood, {OTHER_nameDef}, go hunt a muffalo. Leave the prisoner alone.
Over my dead body. Which, given your mood, is a figure of speech I regret.

cheerful.li: Can we not murder the prisoner? I was just getting to know {ABOUT_nameDef}! They like the same jokes as me!

gloomy.li: Every time we kill someone who's already beaten, we lose a little more of whatever we were before we crashed.

cold.li: An execution upsets half the colony and burns any chance of a ransom. It's poor value.
{ABOUT_nameDef} could be recruited, sold or ransomed. A corpse can only be buried.

plain.li: We let {ABOUT_nameDef} go, and next month they're back with twenty friends and a map of our walls.
{OTHER_nameDef} wants to free {ABOUT_nameDef}. The same {ABOUT_nameDef} who was shooting at us last week?
[afterraid] Their blood's still on our floor. Not yet.

warm.li: I know you mean well, {OTHER_nameDef}. But I've seen what people like {ABOUT_nameDef} do to people like you.

blunt.li: Free {ABOUT_nameDef}? Sure. And then you can explain it to whoever they kill next.
[trait:Bloodlust] I had plans for {ABOUT_nameDef}. Don't ask what they were.

cheerful.li: Releasing raiders, great idea! Next let's leave the door open and put out snacks!

gloomy.li: Mercy is lovely. It's also how colonies get wiped out. I've read the stories.

cold.li: {ABOUT_nameDef} knows our layout and our numbers. Releasing them is handing over intelligence for nothing.
[trait:Psychopath] We've invested a lot of food in {ABOUT_nameDef}. I'd like a return on it.

plain.li: I miss {ABOUT_nameDef} too. But attacking a whole settlement to get one person back could cost us three.
We're not an army. We're a handful of farmers with guns.

blunt.li: {ABOUT_nameDef} is gone. Stop planning a war we'll lose.

gloomy.li: They're probably dead already. I'm sorry. Someone had to say it.

cold.li: Recovering {ABOUT_nameDef} means risking several of us for one. The numbers don't work.
[trait:Psychopath] We can recruit someone with the same skills from the next raid. Cheaper.
